نحترق (form VIII)
# نَحْتَرِقُ (naḥtariqu) /naħ.ta.ri.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَقَ (iḥtaraqa)
# نَحْتَرِقَ (naḥtariqa) /naħ.ta.ri.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَرَقَ (iḥtaraqa)
# نَحْتَرِقْ (naḥtariq) /naħ.ta.riq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْتَرَقَ (iḥtaraqa)
